method: Verbatim-only visual extraction by a 7-agent fan-out (each agent read a batch of screenshots and reported ONLY literally-visible tokens), then cross-checked by the engineer against the AUTHORITATIVE written adjudication. Screenshots CORROBORATE the written facts; they never override them. Neighboring-bore annotations (HH-HH values, DIR. BORE callouts of adjacent runs) are explicitly excluded from a log's support. Per the standing warning, STA 4+54 is NEVER used as log68 geometry (it belongs to log69/log70).

support_level_meaning.CLEAR: a decisive verbatim token (exact HH-HH=N', exact DIR. BORE (N') range, or exact STA reset + structure) matches the log's written fingerprint
support_level_meaning.PARTIAL: corroborating tokens consistent with the log (matchline/street/reset/sheet) but not solely decisive
support_level_meaning.AMBIGUOUS: tokens could fit 2+ logs or partly conflict; recorded but not relied upon
support_level_meaning.NONE: no target-log match; non-target-bore context crop
